definitions.gloss: leisure; having time to spare; being at leisure
definitions.explanation: The state of having free time and not being occupied with work. Often implies wealth or social status that allows for a leisured lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{夫人|ふじん}→夫人：03597_fujin⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧。
examples.english: A gathering of ladies of leisure.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライフスタイル→ライフスタイル：07817_raifusutairu⟧。
examples.english: The lifestyle of the leisure class.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}マダムたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Ladies of leisure are enjoying lunch at a high-end restaurant.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in compound forms rather than alone. {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{夫人|ふじん}→夫人：03597_fujin⟧ and {有閑|ゆうかん}マダム both refer to wealthy women of leisure. {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧ (leisure class) is a sociological term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{夫人|ふじん}→夫人：03597_fujin⟧ (lady of leisure)
- {有閑|ゆうかん}マダム (lady of leisure — more casual)
- {有閑|ゆうかん}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧ (leisure class)

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧ (brave) and ⟦{夕刊|ゆうかん}→夕刊：18550_yuukan⟧ (evening newspaper) share the same reading.
